item.title: Kavak Raises $300 Million In Series F To Expand Financing And Trust Across Latin America
item.description: Mexico City-based Kavak announced it has secured $300 million in Series F funding to accelerate access to car ownership, financing, and marketplace trust across Latin America and other emerging markets. The round was led by Andreessen Horowitz, with $200 million coming from its a16z Growth fund.
